look: tall lean tyrannosaur, lankier than the T. rex: long deep skull with the jaws open, tiny two-fingered arms, long legs, long whip tail, rust-red and orange hide with dark maroon tiger banding, pale cream belly and throat, finer scales, no spinal scutes,

clips.big_stomp: BIGSTOMP: shared big-dinosaur stomp, the near foot hauled high, held, then slammed down under the body (impact 0.72); a direct hit pins (pin_foot)
clips.attack_primary: Slashing bite: the head cocks to one side with the jaws wide, then whips across as the body drives forward, the jaws snapping shut mid-sweep
clips.attack_heavy: Crouch and lunge: it sinks low and coils with the jaws gaping and the tail tip twitching, then explodes forward and clamps
clips.pounce: The burst: one long low bound out of the stalk, jaws thrust ahead, landing on both feet as the jaws slam shut
clips.kick: Tail whip: hips wind one way and the long tail cracks across behind it
clips.pin_foot: Pins a downed victim under its right foot, head low over it
clips.knockdown: Tyrannosaur stumbles and crashes onto its belly, then shoves back up
clips.alert: Tyrannosaur raises its head and roars

tactics._about: SP-TARBOSAURUS (owner 2026-10-30: 'be creative with what moves you think they should do'; Durango reference: low forward stalking pose, head level with the back). A lone ambush tyrant on the saber_cat profile: it closes in on the low stalk creep, and from 10-17 m it BURSTS (attack_heavy is the crouch and coil under the ground ring, then the pounce clip, one long low bound, clamp at landing). A landed burst is an attack_heavy hit, so it applies Pinned and the tarbosaurus plants its foot on the victim (PINFEEL pin_foot). Point blank: the crouch-and-lunge clamp (heavy, also pins), the slashing head-whip bite, and the tail whip when the prey is behind it (the kick slot, kick clip). It also runs prey down (charge, a homing run that ends in the bite). No leaping back: it backs off a step. Its jaws sit ~8 m ahead of its centre, so it bites at reach_m from its middle (TacticalBrain.contact_reach) and lands a burst with the jaws on the prey. Every number an ASSUMPTION (first pass, not balanced).
